changeSet.author: system
changeSet.comment: Seed EMPLOYER role assignment for admin user (idempotent, safe if already exists)
changeSet.sql: INSERT INTO company_user_roles (id, company_id, user_id, role_on_company, access_scope, active, status, version, created_at) SELECT gen_random_uuid(), (SELECT id FROM companies WHERE name = 'TechCorp Bangladesh Ltd' LIMIT 1), (SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = 'admin' LIMIT 1), 'EMPLOYER', 'FULL', true, 'ACTIVE', 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_user_roles WHERE user_id = (SELECT id FROM users WHERE username = 'admin' LIMIT 1) AND company_id = (SELECT id FROM companies WHERE name = 'TechCorp Bangladesh Ltd' LIMIT 1) AND role_on_company = 'EMPLOYER' ) AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM users WHERE username = 'admin') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM companies WHERE name = 'TechCorp Bangladesh Ltd');

delete.where: role_on_company='EMPLOYER' AND user_id=(SELECT id FROM users WHERE username='admin')
